news.title: Shooting in Buford leaves 1 dead, 2 injured during armed robbery, police say
news.summary: A man is dead and two are injured in a Buford shooting, Gwinnett Police report.

news.title: Buford shooting leaves 23-year-old dead during armed robbery
news.summary: Gwinnett County police detectives are investigating a triple shooting during an armed robbery that left one man dead, and two others wounded in Buford.

news.title: Rideshare driver shot by passenger after getting into argument in Atlanta, police say
news.summary: The passenger got out of the vehicle and then shot the driver.

news.title: Atlanta rideshare driver shot during argument with passenger: APD
news.summary: A rideshare driver was shot early Sunday morning after a argument with a passenger in Atlanta, police said.

news.title: Late night gunfire triggers SWAT response at East Point townhome
news.summary: A middle-of-the-night request for a police escort ended in a SWAT standoff in East Point early Sunday morning after officers heard active gunfire, according to authorities.

news.title: Rideshare driver shot after passenger dispute in Atlanta, police investigating
news.summary: The Atlanta Police Department is investigating a shooting from Sunday morning.
